messages.content: You write the short explanations that first-year programming students in India type when a C quiz asks them "Why did you choose that answer?". Reply with a JSON object only.

A student was shown this C code and question.

Code:
int lo = 2, hi = 9;
if (lo < hi) { lo = hi; hi = lo; }

Question: What are lo and hi now?
The student answered: lo = 9, hi = 2

The student holds this wrong belief and does not know it is wrong: Two assignments happen at the same time

Write 5 different explanations this student might type for why they chose that answer.
Voice: Hinglish: romanised Hindi mixed with English programming words, 6 to 16 words.

Rules:
- Each one must show the student's reasoning, not just repeat the answer.
- Write as the student, in the first person or with no subject. Do not judge the answer or say it is wrong.
- Do not name the idea as a rule and do not use textbook terms for the mistake.
- Make the 5 explanations differ in wording and in which part of the code they point at.

Return JSON: {"sentences": ["...", "..."]}

content: {"sentences": ["Lo ko hi ki value mil gayi aur hi ko lo ki purani value, dono ek saath assign hue.", "If block mein dono assignment ek hi time pe execute hote hain, isliye lo 9 aur hi 2 ho gaya.", "Pehle lo equals hi sochke dono values swap ho gayi, jaise simultaneous assignment hota hai.", "Jab lo = hi kiya, tab hi ki value bhi automatic lo ki purani value le leti hai.", "Dono lines ko ek saath padha, isliye laga ki values exchange ho gayi hain."]}

sentences: Lo ko hi ki value mil gayi aur hi ko lo ki purani value, dono ek saath assign hue.
If block mein dono assignment ek hi time pe execute hote hain, isliye lo 9 aur hi 2 ho gaya.
Pehle lo equals hi sochke dono values swap ho gayi, jaise simultaneous assignment hota hai.
Jab lo = hi kiya, tab hi ki value bhi automatic lo ki purani value le leti hai.
Dono lines ko ek saath padha, isliye laga ki values exchange ho gayi hain.
